title: BYO builder: Back/Next buttons + auto-advance between steps
head: byo-step-nav-2026-09-17
body:
Makes the step flow self-explanatory on /pages/build-a-box.

**Buttons**
- New inline Back / Next row under the step content, so navigation is visible without relying on the sticky box bar. Both pairs stay in sync.
- "Continue" renamed to "Next" (last step still reads "Add to cart").
- Hint line between them says what's outstanding: "Pick 4 more cans to continue", "Optional - skip it with Next".

**Auto-advance**
- Picking a box size moves to the beers step (~450ms, so the selection is seen).
- Filling the last slot moves to the gift note step.
- Fires at most once per box per step, so going Back to change a size or swap a can does not shove the customer forward again mid-edit. Clicking Next manually also retires that step's auto-advance.
- Cancelled if the step changed or the step is no longer satisfied when the timer lands.

**Also:** a step change scrolls the step rail back into view (respects prefers-reduced-motion), since the old step change could happen far down the grid with nothing visibly different.

Not yet previewed live - worth a click-through on the theme preview before merge.
